hero.headline: CBSE School in Noida Sector 137: Class 6 to 12 Admission
hero.subhead: Admissions open for Class 6 to 12 at SKS World School, Noida Expressway. CBSE-affiliated, co-ed, English medium.
hero.intro: SKS World School is an English-medium, co-educational, CBSE-affiliated school on the Noida Expressway (Sector 137), run by the SKS Educational & Social Trust under Chairman Shri S.K. Sharma.

welcome.heading: Why Parents Choose SKS World School, Noida Sector 137
paragraphs: SKS World School is an English-medium, co-educational, CBSE-affiliated school on the Noida Expressway (Sector 137), run by the SKS Educational & Social Trust under Chairman Shri S.K. Sharma.
In addition to academics, SKS World School focuses on holistic education beyond books, with a wide range of extracurricular activities that help each child build talent and good values.

about.coreMotive: The core motive behind the efforts made by the schools run under the SKS Group of Institutions has always been to provide a holistic and meaningful education in addition to the pursuit of academic excellence.
about.locationCopy: SKS World School is just opposite Sector 137 Metro Station on the Noida Expressway, so senior students can reach school by metro or school bus.

philosophy.heading: Our Philosophy
philosophy.statement: Understanding the significance of values and learning, we endeavour to encourage holistic development in children. Academic excellence takes the front seat for the foundation of learning. To unleash the unique caliber in every child, we strive towards enriching students with value-based education and individual care so that they can grow up as leaders.

values.name: Harmony and Respect
values.body: We nurture children to value and respect the diversity and develop harmonious relations with others.

values.name: Honesty and Truthfulness
values.body: We believe in preparing students for life and hence, we hone their unique skills that can imbibe honesty and truthfulness in their work and life.

values.name: Thirst for Excellence
values.body: Through seamless knowledge and steady learning, we help children grow a positive attitude and a thirst to keep achieving.

admissions.heading: Class 6 to 12 Admission Process, SKS World School Noida
admissions.intro: A simple four-step process. The admission procedure is friendly and transparent.
admissions.ageCriterion: The applicant should have attained the required age on or before 31st March of the calendar year in which the admission is sought.

steps.title: Registration
steps.body: Register online or collect the form at the Administration Office, open 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM on working days. Submit all required documents so your form can be processed.

steps.title: Interaction
steps.body: We will phone you with the date and time of the interaction and also post it on the school website. Please submit one form per applicant.

steps.title: Selection
steps.body: The school confirms admission after the interaction.

steps.title: Fee Deposit
steps.body: Once admission is confirmed, deposit the fee within the stipulated time to secure the seat. After that date the seat is offered to another applicant.

admissions.rejectionPolicy: Incomplete registration forms and forms providing incorrect information will automatically stand rejected.
admissions.antiDonation: The school does not accept any donation for admission. Parents should be aware of third parties collecting money on behalf of the School and making false claims of procuring admission. If the parents enter into any transaction with such parties, they will be doing so at their own risk and the school shall not be responsible for it.

items.title: Academics
items.body: The Academic Programme is tailored to evolve the intellectual stimulation and curiosity, rational thought and maturity of mind of the student, who is encouraged to pursue the subjects of their choice. CBSE curriculum from Class 6 to 12.

items.title: Co-curricular
items.body: Co-curricular activities develop the temperament of the child and bring out creativity, talent, leadership and character — built on the idea that every child has a personality.

items.title: Physical Education
items.body: Physical Culture at SKS World School fosters sportsmanship, cooperation, team spirit and courage, with the emphasis on Sports for All — do your best, winning is not everything.
